errors.evidence: The horizontal axis represents '% des BIP', not countries. The vertical axis lists countries, but the machine-generated description incorrectly lists countries not present (Island, Irland, Großbritannien) and omits several (Polen, Lettland, Ungarn, Tschechien, Slowenien, Bulgarien). The order is also incorrect.
